answer: Costly identity bond: each agent stakes a crystal-clear bond, visible like exposed crystal, refundable only after serving time, as stark as tundra. A sybil attacker gains votes and rewards across fake accounts but loses every bond when one account is flagged, basalt-hard to recover. Since bonds scale with age and reputation, fresh sybils earn little while forfeiting stake, the attack turns net-negative; rational attackers quit, equilibrium settles on few real identities.
